exposure: types of childhood hospitalisation (none, injury, non-injury, injury-injury)
outcome: binary educational achievement (EA) at grades 6, 9, and 11
cohort: The study included 369,310 children residing in Wales between 2009 and 2016, whose data were linked from five sources within the Secure Anonymised Information Linkage databank.
finding: Social determinants of health moderated the impact of hospital admission type on educational achievement, with lower achievement associated with injury admissions, lower socioeconomic status, and special educational needs, often exacerbated by specific interactions with hospitalisation.
